description: Run a language server refactoring at a position: implement an interface, add or remove struct tags, extract to a new file, move a declaration, and others the server offers there. Call without action to list the refactorings at the position (pass end_line/end_column to select a range, e.g. struct fields). Call with action to run one. Refactorings that need input (gopls v0.24+ interactive refactorings) return status needs_input with their questions: field ids, kinds, options and defaults; call again with answers {field id: value}, and option_queries to search a lazyEnum field's options. Rejected answers come back with an error on the field. The server computes the edit; dry_run=true returns it without writing, otherwise it is applied and diagnostics are reported.

action.description: Title of the refactoring to run (from the list this tool returns without action). Omit to list the refactorings available at the position

answers.description: Answers to the refactoring's questions: {field id: value}. Returned questions list the field ids\, kinds\, options and defaults

dry_run.description: If true\, return the edit without writing it

end_line.description: 1-indexed end line of the selection. Some refactorings need one (e.g. select struct fields to add tags)

file_path.description: Absolute path to the source file

language_id.description: Language identifier (e.g. go\, typescript). Optional; auto-detected from file extension

line.description: 1-indexed line of the code to refactor (start of the selection)

option_queries.description: Search text for searchable fields (kind lazyEnum): {field id: query}\, to narrow the options returned

position_pattern.description: Alternative to line/column: @@pattern@@ syntax matching text at the position

name: refactor
